status_policy.accepted_requires: Verified PR merge into accepted main with required CI passing at exact head; coordinator evidence only.
status_policy.in_review: PR open with exact URL; not a merged capability.
status_policy.refresh: Coordinator reconciles this static file after evidence-backed merges; agents do not edit concurrently.

agent_boundaries.shared: Single coordinator-appointed integration owner per PR; no parallel edits of shared API, models, migrations or UI.

tasks.title: Accept agent coordination pack and contract/interface freeze
acceptance_criteria: Current accepted main and PR #345/#346 state recorded, shared-file collisions classified
Plan, versioned contract seams, file ownership and source-specific rights gates approved
Pack merged after review with required CI passing, no historic AGENTS guidance removed
tasks.coordination_notes: Gate for starting both implementation agents; no code feature marked complete by merging this pack.

tasks.title: Script requirement inventory integration and full coverage
acceptance_criteria: All original script bytes/spans preserved with stable identities and no silent rewrite
All narration beats have typed asset requirements or explicit documented ambiguity; >30 and 100+ cues supported
Script edits invalidate only dependent records; no invented source timestamps
tasks.coordination_notes: Do not duplicate open PR #346; reconcile it before touching parsing integrations.

tasks.title: Bounded search-job planner and provider capability foundation
acceptance_criteria: Typed SourceSearchJobV1 compatible intent with stable idempotency, budget and bounded cursor
Existing adapter capability mapping and deterministic fake-provider dry-run
Quota/timeout/replay errors remain durable and no external paid calls occur in tests
tasks.coordination_notes: Preferred initial A task if PR #346 remains draft; independent of script parser.

tasks.title: Grounded multi-provider scouting and metadata verification
acceptance_criteria: Adapters return true URLs/provider IDs with source/metadata receipts and saved cursors
Reference-only official/YouTube hits never presented as downloadable files
Unreachable, nontransient, rate-limited providers yield bounded actionable gaps

tasks.title: Semantic query expansion from script requirements
acceptance_criteria: Entity aliases, publisher hints, negative terms and alternatives expand requirements meaningfully
Grounded and unverified assertions distinguished; search stays within policy/cost bounds
Repeated execution does not reissue known requests or drop uncovered beats

tasks.title: Rank, diversify and report source coverage and gaps
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic ranker explains verified relevance, authority, availability and rights hard gates
Every requirement has evidence-backed state and alternatives or actionable gap
Candidate counts and link counts cannot falsely imply usable media coverage

tasks.title: Durable channel-safe project Media Bin references
acceptance_criteria: Project-scoped bin links existing owned clips and external URLs with persistent metadata
Idempotent updates; all access restricted to authorized channel/project and correct revision
No duplicate blob copy, no implicit external license, legacy Clip Library remains operational
tasks.coordination_notes: Preferred initial Agent B PR; shared migration file ownership must be reserved.

tasks.title: Media Bin API and operator status surfaces
acceptance_criteria: API lists/adds/inspects owned or reference-only project items with authorization and stable IDs
Real statuses distinguish link saved, review required, denied, acquired and ready
Existing Editorial routes preserved; errors and repeat submissions are deterministic
tasks.coordination_notes: Shared API file modifications need one integration owner; do not race PR #346.

tasks.title: Permission capabilities, rights status and acquisition receipts
acceptance_criteria: Provider-specific download permission separate from access and production eligibility
Durable AcquisitionReceiptV1 differentiates known failed, succeeded and unknown outcome
Revoked/expired/unknown external rights always block selection for production use

tasks.title: Safe and idempotent authorized downloader
acceptance_criteria: Allowlisted authorized media fetch with SSRF/DNS/redirect/size/timeout protection
Partial download and duplicate replays are crash-safe; unknown paid outcomes not blind retried
Reference-only sources remain references; no DRM/auth/ToS circumvention

tasks.title: Multi-type integrity probes and content deduplication
acceptance_criteria: Actual video/image/audio content probed and type/size/duration/dimensions validated
SHA-256 exact and relevant perceptual duplicate records preserved; changed bytes invalidate stale analysis
Validated assets stored canonically without cross-channel leaks or duplicate object writes

tasks.title: Portable project media export with references and evidence
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible ZIP/folder contains permitted physical media, manifests and references/links.csv
Sources, metadata, rights evidence, sha256 and gaps survive export and roundtrip
Never exports credentials, transient signed URLs or externally restricted file bytes

tasks.title: Integrate script-to-source scouting into project Media Bin
acceptance_criteria: Single Find & prepare media journey creates persisted requirements, grounded links and eligible acquired bin items
Crash/replay cannot duplicate media or paid/provider work; exact progress and gaps remain visible
Existing Editor/Clip Library and all permission/rights controls remain intact
tasks.coordination_notes: Agent A sole integration owner, Agent B reviews changed shared files.

tasks.title: Measured shot/frame media index and search
acceptance_criteria: Measured shot ranges/keyframes have source hashes, model policy version and observation coverage
Known-shot fixture retrieval within declared tolerance; no invented timestamps or unseen actions
Index invalidated by media byte changes and bounded CPU/storage/vision costs

tasks.title: Evidence-backed requirement-to-shot matching
acceptance_criteria: Rank source-relative measured intervals per beat with match explanations and fallback gaps
Intervals do not exceed source bounds and current rights reassessed
Operator-locked choices not silently overwritten by recomputation

tasks.title: Safe bindings into existing Editorial direction/storyboard
acceptance_criteria: Versioned bindings handed to current Editor without rewriting its legacy schema
Production eligibility checked again at compile/render; no altered historic renders
One-click/manual replacement verified through tests without silent rights bypass
tasks.coordination_notes: B sole shared-file integration owner, A reviews; multi-shot redesign remains PR #345 scope.

tasks.title: Deterministic end-to-end VisionQuest-style source package acceptance
acceptance_criteria: 100+ visual requirements, owned media and authorized simulated providers create a project media package
Blocked YouTube, stale license, 403, SSRF, duplicate URL, partial fetch, unknown-charge all report honestly
No live provider calls in CI; exact counts, hashes, gaps, timecodes, cost/rights evidence retained
tasks.coordination_notes: Each prior slice still requires its own fixture tests; this ticket adds full-path acceptance.

tasks.title: Authorized real provider/media handoff acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Operator supplies real provider/source authorization and explicit traffic/spend caps
Actual script project saves verified media, links, rights receipts, readable export and source timing evidence
Production readiness claimed only for demonstrated paths; unavailable source/rights remain explicit
tasks.coordination_notes: Never run live acceptance from routine CI or without explicit operator authorization.
